g.text: Keep TMF8829 optical face clear of the wire bundle, mounting holes, screw heads, copper features, boot, and cover-glass occlusion.

g.desc: Keep TMF8829 optical face clear of the wire bundle, mounting holes, screw heads, copper features, boot, and cover-glass occlusion.

g.text: No extra sensor-side ESD arrays are placed in this compact revision; PCB1 protects the cable at the controller connector.

g.desc: No extra sensor-side ESD arrays are placed in this compact revision; PCB1 protects the cable at the controller connector.

g.text: C1/C2/C3/C4 use the datasheet-listed Murata 1 uF 0402. C5 uses the datasheet-listed Murata 2.2 uF 0201 VIO capacitor.

g.desc: C1/C2/C3/C4 use the datasheet-listed Murata 1 uF 0402. C5 uses the datasheet-listed Murata 2.2 uF 0201 VIO capacitor.

g.text: Harness pinout matches PCB1 exactly. J1 pin 3 is TOF_VIO, pin 5 is P1V8_TOF, pins 2/3/5 are not interchangeable.

g.desc: Harness pinout matches PCB1 exactly. J1 pin 3 is TOF_VIO, pin 5 is P1V8_TOF, pins 2/3/5 are not interchangeable.

g.text: PCB2 TMF8829 fingertip sensor board: one sensor, local datasheet capacitors, 16-wire JST NSHD connector, DET resistor, and four small NPTH mounting holes.
